C069.notes: SER NA-JM-001. Arms · crocodile · Taino supporters · OUT OF MANY, ONE PEOPLE · JAMAICA · FIFTY CENTS · 1975. Country #16 · Americas #3 after Costa Rica / Brazil. Independence was only 13 years old; Manley years, reggae on the radio, the motto on every fifty-cent piece in a Kingston till or a tourist’s hotel-change pile. Someone spent this buying bread or a Red Stripe while the islands were still arguing what “out of many” meant in practice. Vault +15 country unlock. SER siblings: NA-JM-002 · NA-JM-003 · NA-JM-004. Jamaica flips now 4.
